items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: So when I joined his band, I stayed with him about two weeks, and I quit him, you know.

ctx.x: Did he have a bass player?

Have a bass player? A bass player, yeah. He named, uh, Richard, Richard, uh, Green, something. Richard Green, something, the bass player. Richard McLean, yeah, that's him, McLean. Oh, Richard McLean, yeah. I know him. Yeah, yeah. He played with I-tay, Viet. I think. He used to play guitar. He got a son, he really can play guitar. Fafu. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Fafu is his name, yeah. Yeah, he really played. I don't know if they, yeah, I've been sick so long, I don't get around him no more, you know. Did you have a way…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I mean Joe Howell I played with him for a little while because he had Frankie Duce in there with him.

ctx.x: Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton for a while. Mm-hm. And then I played with Lewis Dorman band. Mm-hm. And Auguste Dush . I played with Sam Morgan for a good while. Mm-hm. I played a little while with Joe Howell. And that kid Howell I played with him- I mean Joe Howell I played with him for a little while because he had Frankie Duce in there with him. That's right. The boys wouldn't stick with him on account of Frankie Ducey, we all quit. He had a good band too. The kid Howard, I…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Ask him who was in the band when Muck Carey was in the band, I'd be. Right. Yeah, when he finishes there. Then I, uh. He said who was in the band when Muck Carey was there?
Yeah, I know what a dirty mouth he had. He's my mouth, don't you?

Yeah. He was a dirty fellow. Talk dirty. Yeah, he had the women, 30 women. They'd be crazy about it. Yeah. A towel across his shoulder. What, a towel across his shoulder? Yeah. Why? He used to find him to come get me, you know. He used to ask me what I'm playing. I said, I don't want to tell you anything. He's a son, my buddy. And I didn't want to tell you, but they said he wasn't playing with him no more. Well, I would go with him, you know. What band was that? Well, he was tired of. So what band was that? What…
